summary: Initializes one shadow-map cascade view for directional-light rendering: detects whether the cascade already exists via a shadow-config pointer chain, allocates and constructs a 444-byte shadow view object, names it 'SHADOWVIEW%03d', sets projection near/far from the light near plane, clears its color, derives rotation from the light direction, allocates a 76-byte secondary object and a 1024-int array, marks itself initialized, then recursively initializes sibling and child cascade views. Returns 0.

local_names.a2: linked list root used for shadow view data
local_names.a3: recursion enable flag for child views

operations.description: Resolve the shadow-config pointer chain (this+0x18 -> +0x138 -> +0x40); the cascade view is considered absent when the resolved pointer is null or its +0x230 validity flag is zero.
When the cascade already exists (resolved pointer valid), set bit 2 of this+0x24 before continuing.
Skip all recreation when bit 0 of this+0x24 is already set (both the fresh and existing-cascade paths jump to the shared tail).
Format the shadow view name into a 256-byte buffer using the 'SHADOWVIEW%.3d' format string and the view index at this+0x28.
Allocate the 444-byte shadow view object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; when allocation fails the stored pointer stays null.
Construct the allocated object via ConstructorInit.
Store the constructed view pointer at this+0x0C and write a2 into its first word.
Name the shadow view via SoundInstanceInit using the formatted name buffer.
Read the light near-plane value at (this+0x18)->+0x18, double it, add and subtract flt_5DD848 to form a two-field pair, and set it on the shadow view via TwoFieldSetterCall.
Clear the shadow view color via ColorPack(0, 0, 0).
Walk the a2 linked list via LinkedListTraversal and read a direction triple from the node via TripleFieldGetter_d590.
Derive a yaw angle from the direction triple with atan2 of two components, passing the value through FloatConvertWrapper.
Set the shadow view rotation from the derived angles via RandomRotationMatrixFromEulerAngles.
Compute the vertical field-of-view from the light near-plane value and flt_5DD848 via atan2(fabs), doubled, and set the projection angle via sub_542050.
Set the projection extent from dword_8B8DF4 with a square aspect via sub_542200.
Allocate the 76-byte secondary object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and construct it via sub_556220; store the result at this+0x1C.
Initialize the secondary object via sub_556260 with flag 1.
Allocate the 8-byte array object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and initialize it with 1024 ints via IntArrayAllocation; store the result at this+0x20.
Mark the view fully initialized by setting bit 0 of this+0x24.
When the sibling cascade view pointer at this+0x2C is non-null, recursively call sub_560C10(a2, 1) to initialize it.
When the child cascade view pointer at this+0x34 is non-null and a3 is set, recursively call sub_560C10(a2, 1) to initialize it.
Return 0.
